title: Review pull requests
description: Comment a code review on every pull request that is opened or updated.

modes.prompt: Review the change for correctness, tests and clarity. Be specific and brief. Read the change with git (git diff, git log). Do not edit files or push.

title: Triage new issues
description: Label each new issue and comment a short summary.

modes.prompt: Read the issue and the code it concerns. Summarise it in two or three sentences and say what it needs.

title: Implement issues on request
description: Plan the fix, implement it and open a pull request when an issue gets the ez label, gets an `@enzarb implement` comment from someone with write access, or Implement is clicked in enzarb.

modes.prompt: Read the issue and the code and write a short plan. Do not edit files.
Implement the plan with small, tested changes.

workflow.description: Implement issues on request (label ez, @enzarb implement comment or the Implement button) and open a pull request
workflow.if: (event.name == 'issues' and event.action == 'labeled' and event.label.name == 'ez') or (event.name == 'issue_comment' and event.issue.pull_request is undefined and event.issue.state == 'open' and event.comment.user.type != 'Bot' and event.comment.author_association in ['OWNER', 'MEMBER', 'COLLABORATOR'] and event.comment.body | regex_match('(?im)^[[:space:]]*@enzarb[[:space:]]+implement([[:space:]]|$)')) or event.name == 'manual'

failed.reason: the implementer made no push for issue #{{ event.issue.number }}

title: Fix failing CI
description: When the repository's own CI fails, try a fix and open a pull request against the default branch. The agent starts from the failing branch, but the fix is a separate pull request, not a push to that branch. Runs that fail for reasons outside the code (for example a rate-limited bot) end failed with the agent's explanation.

modes.prompt: Find why the CI run failed, fix the cause with the smallest change and run the tests. Some failures have nothing to fix in code (a rate limit, an outage, a flaky service): then change nothing. Either way finish by submitting a result whose summary says what you found.

fix.instruction: The CI run {{ event.workflow_run.name }} failed on {{ event.workflow_run.head_branch }}. See {{ event.workflow_run.html_url }}.

failed.reason: the CI fixer made no push: {{ nodes.fix.result.summary if nodes.fix.result is defined and nodes.fix.result else 'no summary was submitted' }}
